For real equiangular tight frames with \(n>d+1\), we determine the exact recovery threshold in terms of the coherence. The proof of this result for real equiangular tight frames relies on a novel characterization---which should be of independent interest to frame theorists---of the distribution of signs in the Gram matrix.
summary_zh: 本文利用框架理论与压缩感知工具，建立了神经网络中叠加效应的数学理论。在我们的模型中，由活跃特征构成的稀疏二元向量x通过过完备字典W完成编码，特征恢复过程通过带合适偏置向量b的ReLU(WᵀWx+b)操作实现。我们针对该模型证明了多项恢复定理：在随机支撑场景下，针对近紧、低相干性字典，我们建立了高概率支撑恢复保证，可支持的期望稀疏度最高可达d/log n量级；在最坏情况支撑场景下，我们给出了可实现支撑恢复的稀疏度水平的精确可计算判据。我们将该判据应用于高斯随机矩阵与等角紧框架，针对n>d+1的实值等角紧框架，基于相干性确定了精确恢复阈值。该实值等角紧框架相关结论的证明依赖于Gram矩阵符号分布的全新表征，该表征对框架理论研究者也具有独立的参考价值。

title: Ab initio Modeling of MoS2/Oxide Device Interfaces with Machine Learned Electronic Structures
title_zh: 结合机器学习电子结构的MoS₂/氧化物器件界面从头算建模
authors: Manasa Kaniselvan, Mauro Dossena, Denghui Lu, Alexander Maeder, Nicolas Vetsch 等 (7 人)
abstract: We introduce a new ab initio approach to simulate semiconductor devices that integrates scalable machine-learned (ML) electronic structure models with an advanced quantum transport (QT) solver. The developed framework enables 10,000X speedups over density functional theory to produce the Hamiltonian matrix of devices made of >20,000 atoms, while offering high prediction accuracy. We use its unique features to investigate MoS2/oxide samples and single-layer MoS2 field-effect transistors, where the surrounding oxide layers, here, HfO2 or Al2O3, are explicitly included into the QT domain. In particular, we reveal that the presence of undercoordinated metal atoms (Hf or Al) close to the semiconductor-oxide interface significantly affects the magnitude of the electronic current and its propagation through MoS2.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种模拟半导体器件的全新从头算方法，将可扩展的机器学习电子结构模型与先进的量子输运（QT）求解器相集成。所开发的框架相比密度泛函理论实现了10000倍的加速，可生成包含超过20000个原子的器件哈密顿矩阵，同时保持较高的预测精度。我们利用该框架的独特特性研究了MoS₂/氧化物样品与单层MoS₂场效应晶体管，其中周围的氧化物层（HfO₂或Al₂O₃）被显式纳入量子输运计算域。研究特别发现，半导体-氧化物界面附近低配位金属原子（Hf或Al）的存在会显著影响电流大小及其在MoS₂中的传播过程。

title: Dandelion: A Spherical Flower for Neural Simulation of Planetary Dynamics
title_zh: 当Muon优化器遇上任务干扰：从谱视角看持续学习与模型合并
authors: Till Muser, Giovanni Abati, Ivan Dokmanić
abstract: Many dynamical processes unfold on the sphere but the default scientific machine learning architectures are Euclidean. Applying these architectures on a regular lat-lon grid causes problems: Cartesian convolutions become distorted at high latitude; 2D FFTs in Fourier neural operators incorrectly assume double periodicity; Cartesian positional encodings in ViTs distort spherical geodesic distances. Recent work moves towards natively spherical primitives, including spherical convolutions (e.g., DeepSphere or DISCO), Spherical Fourier Neural Operators (SFNOs), and geodesic attention. Here we propose Dandelion, a spherical version of Flower, a warp-based neural PDE solver. Layers of Dandelion predict a tangent-plane displacement and transport features along great circles. We obtain a U-Net-like structure by implementing hierarchical pooling entirely in the spherical-harmonic domain. There are thus no convolutions: spatial mixing is achieved only through spherical coordinate changes, or warps. To compare Dandelion with existing spherical architectures, we release an evolving benchmark suite of challenging, natively-spherical PDE datasets including a modified Galewsky jet, anomalous chained turbulence, Cahn-Hilliard decomposition, spherical Riemann shocks, Held-Suarez dry atmospheric transport and global ocean dynamics. This new benchmark fills the gap in existing spherical datasets which are either too small and stylized, or much too large (ERA5) for model iteration. Dandelion is best or second-best on every dataset, and the gap to non-warp baselines widens with resolution: at $256\times 512$, Dandelion and Flower2D occupy the top two slots in both single-step prediction and rollout.
summary_zh: 持续学习（CL）与模型合并（MM）的目标均为获得可在多任务上表现优异的单一模型，二者分别面临灾难性遗忘与权重解耦误差的挑战。现有文献通常将两类问题分开处理，通过多种方案缓解相关问题，而将基础优化器引入的几何特性视为实现细节。本文证明两类挑战本质上是同一现象的不同表现：针对某一任务有效的参数更新会改变模型在另一任务上的输出。我们将这一共性现象形式化为任务干扰，将其简化为通用的逐层Frobenius内积⟨ΔW_ℓ, J_ℓ(x)⟩_F。利用该量可进一步揭示优化器的作用，我们从理论上推导出一个上界，将谱范数∥ΔW_ℓ∥₂分离为优化器可调控的任务干扰因子，单模态分析表明该上界可追踪经验干扰的主导部分。据此我们发现近期提出的Muon优化器可从构造层面调控该因子，其对谱范数的优雅控制可收紧持续学习与模型合并场景下的干扰上界，使Muon成为与现有方案互补的、以优化器为核心的原则性解决思路。我们的理论分析得到了大量实验结果的充分验证：在基于三种CLIP骨干网络的八任务模型合并基准测试中，使用Muon替换AdamW优化器可将准确率最高提升5.02个点；在持续学习场景下，Muon在10个类增量协议、3个任务增量协议与11任务MTIL基准测试中均实现了一致的正向性能提升。

title: When Muon Meets Task Interference: A Spectral Perspective on Continual Learning and Model Merging
authors: Shangge Liu, Yuehan Yin, Yinghuan Shi, Lei Wang, Wenbin Li
abstract: Continual learning (CL) and model merging (MM) both aim to obtain a single model that performs well across multiple tasks, challenged respectively by catastrophic forgetting and weight-disentanglement error. In the literature, these difficulties are merely treated separately and mitigated through a variety of solutions, while the geometry induced by the base optimizer is treated as an implementation detail. In this work, we show that the two difficulties are in fact two instances of the same phenomenon: a parameter update useful for one task shifts the model's outputs on another. We formalize this shared phenomenon as \textit{task interference} and reduce it to a common layer-wise Frobenius inner product $\langle \Delta W_\ell, J_\ell(x)\rangle_F$. This quantity, in turn, is utilized to expose the role of the optimizer. We theoretically derive an upper bound that isolates the spectral norm $\|\Delta W_\ell\|_2$ as an optimizer-controllable factor of task interference, and a per-mode analysis shows that this bound tracks the dominant part of the empirical interference. Specifically, we then identify the recent Muon optimizer as a mechanism that regulates this factor by construction. Our work reveals that its elegant control on spectral norm tightens the interference bound for both CL and MM, positioning Muon as a principled optimizer-centric approach complementary to existing solutions. Our theoretcal analysis is well validated by experimental results. Replacing the AdamW optimizer with Muon improves accuracy by up to +5.02 points on the eight-task model-merging benchmark across three CLIP backbones. For continual learning, Muon also delivers uniformly positive gains across ten class-incremental protocols, three task-incremental protocols, and the 11-task MTIL benchmark.

title: How Do Linear Probes Emerge? A Circuit-Tracing Framework with Concept-Targeted Attribution
title_zh: 线性探针是如何产生的？面向概念归因的电路追踪框架
authors: Vedant Palit, Florent Draye, Terry Jingchen Zhang, Bernhard Schölkopf, Zhijing Jin
abstract: Transcoder attribution graphs are usually trained to explain why a model assigns high probability to a particular next token. We introduce Concept-Targeted Attribution (CTA), which instead trains attribution graphs with respect to a linear probe direction. CTA therefore yields probe-specific circuits that explain why an internal concept representation arises in a prompt, independently of whether it is expressed in the generated token. Using Cross-Layer Transcoders, we show that these probe-targeted graphs contain predictive structure: graph-level features predict probe accuracy across four widely studied concept categories ($\rho = 0.91$, $R^2 = 0.84$), while local features identify the sparse components driving per-prompt classification. This connects probe performance to interpretable circuit structure, allowing us to ask not only whether a probe works, but which internal computations make it work. Causal ablations further show that probe-targeted and logit-targeted graphs capture functionally distinct mechanisms. Removing probe-relevant features reduces internal concept scores while largely preserving generated tokens, whereas removing logit-relevant features changes the generated token in 92% to 100% of cases with near-zero effect on probe scores. CTA provides a framework for moving from behavioral probe accuracy to mechanistic explanations of probe performance, enabling more detailed audits of internal concept representations, including safety-critical ones. Our code is available atthis https URL
summary_zh: 转码器归因图通常用于解释模型为何会为特定下一个token分配高概率。本文提出面向概念的归因（Concept-Targeted Attribution, CTA）方法，针对线性探针方向训练归因图，生成探针专属的电路，解释内部概念表征为何会在提示中出现，与该概念是否在生成的token中表达无关。通过跨层转码器的实验表明，这类面向探针的图包含可预测的结构特征：图级特征可预测四类广泛研究的概念类别的探针准确率（ρ=0.91，R²=0.84），局部特征可识别驱动单提示分类的稀疏组件。该关联将探针性能与可解释的电路结构联系起来，不仅可以验证探针是否有效，还可揭示支撑探针工作的内部计算机制。因果消融实验进一步表明，面向探针与面向对数几率的图捕获了功能完全不同的机制：移除探针相关特征会降低内部概念得分，但基本不改变生成的token；而移除对数几率相关特征会在92%~100%的场景下改变生成的token，且对探针得分几乎无影响。CTA提供了从探针行为准确率转向探针性能机理解释的框架，支持对内部概念表征（包括安全关键类表征）的更精细审计。相关代码已在指定开源链接公开。

title: Optimal Transport for Network Comparison: A Review with Machine Learning Applications
title_zh: 面向网络比对的最优传输：综述及机器学习应用
authors: James Hyun, François G. Meyer
abstract: Network comparison using optimal transport is a growing area of research in network science. Unlike standard graph metrics, optimal transport computes both network dissimilarity and a transport plan that explains how one graph morphs into another. In this paper, we review how optimal transport compares undirected, unweighted graphs using three primary distances: the Wasserstein, Gromov-Wasserstein, and Bures-Wasserstein distances. We examine the closed form of the Wasserstein distance in one dimension via node feature probability distributions, and show how the transport plans of the Wasserstein and Gromov-Wasserstein distances capture which specific nodes influence the distance after graph perturbation. For the Bures-Wasserstein distance, we derive bounds using Laplacian spectra to bypass full spectral decompositions. Finally, we evaluate these distances using a synthetic network dataset for clustering and a real-world time series network for anomaly detection.
summary_zh: 基于最优传输的网络比对是网络科学领域快速发展的研究方向。与传统图度量不同，最优传输方法既可以计算网络间的相异度，也可以生成解释一个图如何演变为另一个图的传输方案。本文综述了最优传输方法如何利用三类核心距离（瓦瑟斯坦距离、格罗莫夫-瓦瑟斯坦距离、布雷斯-瓦瑟斯坦距离）完成无向无权图的比对。我们通过节点特征概率分布推导了一维场景下瓦瑟斯坦距离的闭式解，展示了瓦瑟斯坦距离与格罗莫夫-瓦瑟斯坦距离的传输方案可识别图扰动后具体哪些节点会对距离产生影响。针对布雷斯-瓦瑟斯坦距离，我们基于拉普拉斯谱推导了相关边界，无需执行完整的谱分解。最后我们分别在面向聚类的合成网络数据集与面向异常检测的真实时序网络数据集上对三类距离的性能进行了评估。

title: Multiscale Community-Based Fingerprinting of Signed Functional Networks
title_zh: 基于多尺度社区的符号功能网络指纹识别
authors: Sema Athamnah, Selin Aviyente
abstract: Objective: Recent studies demonstrate that functional connectomes contain subject-specific signatures, or \textit{fingerprints}, that can identify individuals across repeated sessions and tasks. Existing methods mostly rely on edge-level features that are sensitive to noise, difficult to interpret, and limited in their ability to generalize across tasks and datasets. Methods: We propose a multiscale community-based functional connectome fingerprinting framework that characterizes each individual by the mesoscale structure of their functional networks. We introduce a signed multilayer community detection framework that incorporates both correlated and anti-correlated brain activity to identify subject-specific community structures across tasks and sessions. Graph-theoretic metrics are then computed from the resulting joint community structures to derive low-dimensional community-level fingerprint representations. Results: The proposed framework is evaluated on 810 healthy control subjects from the Human Connectome Project (HCP). The results show that community-based fingerprints provide a reliable and interpretable substrate for individualized brain characterization across sessions and tasks. Conclusion: Mesoscale community structure provides meaningful and discriminative subject-specific fingerprints. Significance: The proposed framework offers a promising foundation for precision neuroimaging and personalized neuroscience applications.
summary_zh: 研究目的：近期研究表明功能连接组包含受试者专属的特征（即指纹），可跨多次会话与任务实现个体身份识别。现有方法大多依赖边级特征，这类特征对噪声敏感、可解释性差，跨任务与数据集的泛化能力有限。研究方法：本文提出一种基于多尺度社区的功能连接组指纹识别框架，通过个体功能网络的介观尺度结构表征每个受试者。我们引入符号多层社区检测框架，同时纳入大脑的相关与反相关活动，跨任务与会话识别受试者专属的社区结构，随后从得到的联合社区结构中计算图论度量，生成低维社区级指纹表征。研究结果：所提框架在来自人类连接组计划（HCP）的810名健康对照受试者数据集上完成验证，结果表明基于社区的指纹可为跨会话、跨任务的个体化大脑表征提供可靠且可解释的基础。研究结论：介观尺度社区结构可生成具有区分度的、有意义的受试者专属指纹。研究意义：所提框架为精准神经成像与个性化神经科学应用提供了极具前景的基础支撑。

title: Accelerating LLM Inference via Vector Index Based Output Embeddings
title_zh: 基于向量索引的输出嵌入加速大语言模型推理
authors: Martin Loretz, Sepp Hochreiter
abstract: Large output embedding matrices create a significant memory bandwidth bottleneck during autoregressive decoding, especially for compact LLMs with large multilingual vocabularies. We reformulate the output projection followed by top-k token selection as a maximum inner product search over token embeddings and replace the dense vocabulary projection with an HNSW-based vector index. The resulting output head retrieves only a small candidate set of high-scoring tokens and can be integrated into existing decoding pipelines by scattering retrieved logits into a sparse full-vocabulary tensor. On CPU inference with Gemma 3, Llama 3.2, and Qwen 3 models, our method substantially accelerates the output projection and improves end-to-end batch-size-one decoding throughput by up to 82% for Gemma 3 270M, while preserving generation quality under AlpacaEval evaluation. These results suggest approximate retrieval is a practical alternative to dense output projections in latency-sensitive small-batch decoding.
summary_zh: 大尺寸输出嵌入矩阵会在自回归解码过程中造成严重的内存带宽瓶颈，对于拥有大规模多语言词表的紧凑型大语言模型（LLM）而言该问题尤为突出。本文将输出投影加top-k token选择的过程重构为token嵌入上的最大内积搜索，采用基于层次化导航小世界图（HNSW）的向量索引替换稠密词表投影。改进后的输出头仅检索少量高得分token候选集，可通过将检索得到的对数几率散射到稀疏的全词表张量中，无缝集成到现有解码流水线中。在Gemma 3、Llama 3.2与Qwen 3模型的CPU推理场景下，本文方法可大幅加速输出投影过程，在批量大小为1的解码场景下，Gemma 3 270M的端到端吞吐量最高可提升82%，且在AlpacaEval评测中生成质量无损失。实验结果表明，近似检索是延迟敏感的小批量解码场景下稠密输出投影的实用替代方案。

title: A Formal Limitation on Learning Human Language From Textual Corpora
title_zh: 从文本语料库学习人类语言的形式化局限性
authors: Emily Cheng, Ryan Cotterell
abstract: Can a listener recover what a speaker means from the form of an utterance alone? We answer this question information-theoretically, and for a listener given by any featurizer of text, including the hidden states of contemporary large language models. Modeling language use as a joint distribution over meanings, contexts, and utterances, we derive upper bounds on the probability that a decoder recovers a speaker's intended meaning from a representation of the utterance. The bounds are governed by the uncertainty that form leaves about meaning, which splits into an irreducible part and a part that only (extralinguistic) context, but never the utterance alone, can resolve. Because these quantities are intrinsic to language, no representation, however much text or supervision produced it, can surpass them; the bounds hold whether the space of meanings is discrete or continuous. Experiments on artificial languages, Mandarin zero-pronoun resolution, and color reference provide empirical evidence in support of the theory.
summary_zh: 听者能否仅依靠话语形式本身推断出说话者的表意？本文从信息论角度回答了这一问题，研究对象涵盖任意文本特征提取器对应的听者，包括当前主流大语言模型的隐藏状态。本研究将语言使用建模为表意、上下文与话语的联合分布，推导得出解码器仅通过话语表征恢复说话者预期表意的概率上界。该上界由话语形式在表意层面留下的不确定性决定，这类不确定性可分为不可约部分和仅能由（语言外）上下文而非话语本身消解的部分。由于这些属性是语言的固有特性，无论通过多少文本量或监督信号训练得到的表征，都无法突破该上界；且无论表意空间是离散还是连续，该边界均成立。在人工语言、中文零代词消解、颜色指代任务上开展的实验结果均为该理论提供了实证支撑。

title: Phoneme- and Word-Level Metrics Using Self-Supervised Speech Representations for Forced Alignment Evaluation
title_zh: 基于自监督语音表征的音素级与词级强制对齐评估指标
authors: V.S.D.S.Mahesh Akavarapu, Michael Daniel, Gerhard Jäger
abstract: Forced alignment evaluation typically requires manually annotated timestamps, limiting large-scale and multilingual analysis. We introduce two corpus-level metrics based on self-supervised (SSL) speech representations for reference-free forced alignment evaluation: Phoneme-Cluster Mutual Information (PCMI) and Word Acoustic Consistency Score (WACS). PCMI measures agreement between aligned phoneme labels and clusters induced from SSL-speech representations, while WACS measures consistency of repeated word realizations using dynamic time warping similarity between word representation sequences. Using both random and systematic perturbations, we show that PCMI and WACS degrade consistently under alignment perturbations. We further analyze the metrics across multiple alignment systems on 85 languages from FLEURS, validate them against manually annotated alignments from 45 languages in DoReCo, and evaluate them on two phonologically complex low-resource languages. The metrics effectively separate high- and low-quality alignments and correlate strongly with timestamp-based alignment quality measures. Our results demonstrate that SSL-speech representations enable scalable, reference-free forced alignment evaluation. The metrics are available as an open-source Python package atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 强制对齐评估通常需要人工标注的时间戳，限制了大规模多语言分析的开展。本文提出两项基于自监督（SSL）语音表征的语料级指标，用于无参考强制对齐评估：Phoneme-Cluster Mutual Information（PCMI，音素簇互信息）和Word Acoustic Consistency Score（WACS，单词声学一致性得分）。其中PCMI用于衡量对齐后的音素标签与自监督语音表征生成的聚类结果之间的一致性，WACS则通过单词表征序列间的动态时间规整相似度，衡量重复单词发音的一致性。通过随机扰动与系统扰动实验，本文证明PCMI和WACS的性能会随对齐结果的扰动同步下降。研究进一步在FLEURS数据集覆盖的85种语言上对多个对齐系统开展指标分析，使用DoReCo数据集中45种语言的人工标注对齐结果完成指标验证，并在两种音系结构复杂的低资源语言上完成评估。结果表明，两类指标可有效区分高质量与低质量对齐结果，且与基于时间戳的对齐质量度量高度相关。研究证实自监督语音表征可支持可扩展的无参考强制对齐评估，相关指标已作为开源Python包发布。

title: Ladders in Chaos: When, How, (and Perhaps Why) Does Test-Time Scaling Improve LLM Machine Translation
title_zh: 混沌中的阶梯：测试时缩放何时、如何（以及为何）提升大语言模型的机器翻译性能
authors: Di Wu, Sergey Troshin, Christof Monz, Antske Fokkens, Vlad Niculae
abstract: Two forms of test-time scaling for Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as effective and widely adopted paradigms: sequential, in which later answer attempts depend on earlier ones, and parallel, such as i.i.d. sampling with reranking. In this study, we investigate their properties in translation. First, our study shows that sequential sampling has a higher performance ceiling, providing a more diverse and effective pool of samples, particularly under smaller sampling budgets. Second, we interrogate the nature of test-time scaling through a multidimensional manual analysis. Human analysis of the Best-of-$N$ translations demonstrates that sequential sampling substantially improves translation fluency and naturalness, but can degrade accuracy when inference budgets are large. Finally, we suggest an explanation of the mechanism through which sequential scaling improves machine translation. Our controlled analysis partially attributes the success of sequential self-improvement to the model's access to a larger target-side context. Ablation experiments on sequential sampling demonstrate its robustness across different sampling temperatures, while also revealing sensitivity to context construction, suggesting directions for future improvement.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的两类测试时缩放范式已得到广泛应用并验证有效：一类是串行范式，后续生成的回答依赖于之前的生成结果；另一类是并行范式，例如带重排序的独立同分布采样。本研究针对两类范式在翻译任务中的特性展开探究：首先，研究结果表明串行采样的性能上限更高，可生成更多样、更优质的样本池，在采样预算有限的场景下优势尤为明显；其次，通过多维度人工分析探究测试时缩放的内在特性，针对Best-of-N翻译结果的人工分析显示，串行采样可大幅提升翻译的流畅度与自然度，但在推理预算过高时可能损害翻译准确性；最后，本研究提出了串行缩放提升机器翻译性能的作用机制解释，受控分析结果表明，串行自提升的效果部分来源于模型可获取更大的目标端上下文。针对串行采样的消融实验验证了其在不同采样温度下的鲁棒性，同时也发现其对上下文构建方式较为敏感，为后续优化指明了方向。

title: Blind Men and the Elephant: Probing the Epistemic Myopia of LLMs under Long-Tail Divergent Knowledge
title_zh: 盲人摸象：长尾分歧知识下大语言模型的认知短视性探测
authors: Zhuoshi Pan, Junru Lu, Yan Qian, H. Vicky Zhao, Di Yin 等 (6 人)
abstract: Factual question answering (QA) typically assumes a single canonical answer, obscuring whether large language models (LLMs) retain divergent accounts of long-tail facts. To address this gap, we introduce ElephantBench, a closed-book knowledge probe comprising 1,094 questions generated through an auditable graph-based pipeline. The pipeline retrieves related documents from a low-exposure web corpus, identifies naturally occurring disagreements, and converts them into multi-account QA records. Each answer is verified against the originating documents and authoritative public web sources and is then reviewed by human annotators. Across 32 models, even the strongest model recovers both accounts on only 52.4% of questions, while on nearly all remaining questions it recalls one account but omits the other. Scaling model size and inference-time reasoning improve recall but do not eliminate this incompleteness. Corpus analysis further shows that exposure imbalance favors the dominant account, whereas greater minority-side exposure is associated with more complete recall. These findings establish ElephantBench as a reproducible knowledge probe for diagnosing epistemic myopia in parametric memory. More broadly, our graph-based benchmark construction pipeline provides an efficient and scalable way to turn long-tail corpora into source-traceable knowledge probes, supporting efforts to evaluate and advance the epistemic rigour of next-generation LLMs. Code is available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 事实类问答（QA）任务通常默认问题仅有单一标准回答，掩盖了大语言模型（LLM）是否保留长尾事实的不同表述这一问题。为填补该研究空白，本文提出ElephantBench，这是一套包含1094道问题的闭卷知识探测集，所有问题通过可审计的图流水线生成：该流水线从低曝光网页语料中检索相关文档，识别自然存在的事实分歧，将其转换为多表述问答记录，所有答案均经过原始文档与权威公开网页源的交叉验证，最终由人工标注员审核完成。在32个大模型上开展的测试结果显示，即便是性能最优的模型，也仅能在52.4%的问题上同时回忆起两种事实表述，其余近半数问题仅能回忆起其中一种表述、遗漏另一种。扩大模型规模、引入推理时推理机制可提升召回率，但无法完全消除该类信息缺失问题。语料分析进一步表明，语料曝光度的不平衡会让模型更倾向于主流事实表述，而提升小众表述的语料曝光度可提升模型对完整事实的召回率。上述结果证明ElephantBench是可复现的参数内存认知短视性诊断探测集，本文提出的基于图的基准集构建流水线可高效、可扩展地将长尾语料转换为来源可追溯的知识探测集，为下一代大语言模型的认知严谨性评估与优化提供支撑。相关代码已开源。

title: ContextPilot: Teaching Agents for Proactive Context Management via Fine-grained RL
title_zh: ContextPilot：基于细粒度强化学习教导智能体实现主动上下文管理
authors: Zhuoshi Pan, Qizhi Pei, Junru Lu, Honglin Lin, H. Vicky Zhao 等 (7 人)
abstract: Long-horizon agentic tasks require large language models (LLMs) to iteratively retrieve, integrate, and maintain dispersed information across multi-turn interactions, but preserving all interaction histories leads to a continuously growing working context. Recent proactive context management methods allow models to edit their own working context with specialized tools, yet they still face three key limitations: (1) a limited toolset restricted to search, deletion, and summarization, with no support for global planning, long-term memory, and adaptive compression; (2) inefficient exploration that treats context management actions uniformly despite their heterogeneous impacts on final outcomes; and (3) coarse-grained credit assignment that assigns the final trajectory-level reward to all intermediate context editing actions during RL. To bridge these gaps, we introduce ContextPilot, a proactive context management framework for long-horizon agentic reasoning. Our approach systematically augments the toolset with planning, long-term memory, and soft context offloading tools. We further propose an RL method tailored for context management, which uses context and entropy variation to identify critical editing decisions for branch sampling and estimates action-level advantages from all branched trajectories that pass through the corresponding context editing action. Experiments on long-context QA and deep search tasks show that ContextPilot achieves stronger performance with a more compact working context, consistently outperforming existing baselines across various base models and benchmarks. Code is available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 长周期智能体任务要求大语言模型（LLM）在多轮交互中迭代检索、整合并维护分散的信息，但如果保留全部交互历史会导致工作上下文持续膨胀。现有主动上下文管理方法允许模型通过专用工具编辑自身工作上下文，但仍存在三大核心局限：（1）工具集仅支持搜索、删除、摘要操作，缺乏全局规划、长期记忆与自适应压缩能力；（2）探索效率低下，未考虑不同上下文管理动作对最终结果的差异化影响，对所有动作采用统一处理逻辑；（3）强化学习过程中的信用分配粒度较粗，将最终轨迹级奖励平均分配给所有中间上下文编辑动作。为解决上述问题，本文提出ContextPilot，面向长周期智能体推理的主动上下文管理框架：该框架在原有工具集基础上新增规划、长期记忆、软上下文卸载三类工具，同时提出面向上下文管理定制的强化学习方法，利用上下文与熵变识别关键编辑决策用于分支采样，从所有经过对应上下文编辑动作的分支轨迹中估计动作级优势函数。在长上下文问答与深度搜索任务上的实验结果表明，ContextPilot可在更紧凑的工作上下文下实现更优性能，在不同基础模型与基准集上均持续优于现有基线方法。相关代码已开源。

title: Stranger, Fan, or Peer? A Systematic Study on the Role of Interlocutor in Persona-Based Dialogue Generation
title_zh: 用于可解释多维度作文评分的结构化反馈生成统一框架
authors: Daniela Occhipinti, Malvina Nissim, Marco Guerini
abstract: Persona-based dialogue systems are usually conditioned on speaker biography, but dialogues involve at least two participants, and who has access to whose biography can vary across training, inference, and evaluation. Prior work often neglected these aspects, obscuring mechanisms that only appear when biography visibility is toggled separately across training, inference, and evaluation, a three-stage factorisation that prior work has largely treated as a single factor. We study this factorisation on a dataset of dialogues paired with speaker's biographies, varying whether the target and interlocutor speakers see each other's biographies during training and inference, and using an LLM as a judge to perform author identification. We find that (i) training-time visibility, more than inference-time visibility, determines whether models express persona traits through dialogue or fall back on copying biographical text (a known problem/phenomenon in persona-based generation); (ii) models trained with interlocutor-biography visibility copy less target-biographical text than models trained without it, while changing visibility only at inference time has a less consistent effect; and (iii) under asymmetric disclosure, where only the interlocutor sees the target biography, target content leaks into interlocutor turns more often, and dialogues containing such traces are easier for the judge to identify, especially when interlocutor turns are visible. These results suggest that biography leakage into generated turns is an artefact of how interlocutor visibility is configured across training and inference, and separating the three stages is necessary.
summary_zh: 多维度自动作文评分（AES）要求模型基于评分标准对相互关联的多个评分维度开展推理，而非仅做孤立的分数预测。现有反馈增强类方法通常将反馈生成与评分任务解耦，或独立评估各个维度，导致分数与反馈的一致性不足，与评分标准的匹配度较低。本文提出HiFTS，一种统一的自回归框架，可在预测维度得分与总得分之前生成层级化思维链（CoT）反馈。HiFTS首先从教师大模型中蒸馏得到符合评分标准的层级化思维链反馈，训练学生模型联合生成反馈与得分，进一步引入组相对策略优化机制，使用复合奖励平衡分数一致性、校准度、反馈质量与结构有效性。推理阶段引入轻量级全局先验提供全局引导，减少长文本推理过程中的漂移问题。本文还构建了中文多维度自动作文评分数据集CFMS-34，包含951篇标注了总得分与34项基于评分标准的维度得分的作文。在CFMS-34与ASAP++数据集上的实验结果表明，HiFTS在总得分与维度评分任务上均取得优异性能，同时可生成逻辑连贯、符合评分标准的反馈内容。

title: A Unified Framework to Elicit Structured Feedback for Interpretable Multi-Trait Essay Scoring
title_zh: CultureConverse：面向东亚和东南亚文化适配辅助的多语言多轮仿真测试框架
authors: Shihang Yang, Sanwoo Lee, Ningning Zhao, Yunfang Wu
abstract: Multi-trait Automated Essay Scoring (AES) requires rubric-grounded reasoning across interdependent traits, rather than isolated score prediction. Existing feedback-enhanced methods often decouple feedback from scoring or assess traits independently, weakening score--feedback consistency and rubric alignment. We propose HiFTS, a unified autoregressive framework that generates hierarchical CoT feedback before predicting trait-level and holistic scores. HiFTS distills rubric-grounded hierarchical CoT feedback from a teacher LLM and trains student models to jointly generate feedback and scores. HiFTS further applies Group Relative Policy Optimization with a composite reward balancing score agreement, calibration, feedback quality, and structural validity. At inference, a lightweight global prior provides holistic guidance to reduce drift during long-form reasoning. We also introduce CFMS-34, a Chinese multi-trait AES dataset with 951 essays annotated with holistic scores and 34 rubric-based traits. Experiments on CFMS-34 and ASAP++ show that HiFTS achieves strong holistic and trait-level scoring while producing coherent, rubric-aligned feedback.
summary_zh: 当前大语言模型（LLM）的文化评估通常将文化简化为单轮事实回忆类多项选择题，无法覆盖真实场景中用户在文化相关场景下通过多轮交互寻求实用帮助的典型用例。本文提出CultureConverse，面向文化适配智能体对话的可扩展多语言仿真评估框架，覆盖东亚与东南亚的10个地区、58个子群体身份与7个应用领域。每一条仿真评估交互记录均包含打分结果，智能体需要为用户提供辅助，并从部分信息中推断对应的文化约束。最终得到的CultureConverse-DS数据集包含14610条基准评估交互记录与274295条基于标准答案引导的对话样本。在18个大模型上开展的基准评估结果显示，GPT-5 mini的文化辅助质量最高。人工标注实验验证了本文提出的评估框架可有效替代人工评判。在27860条高质量CultureConverse-DS样本上开展微调后，模型的域内文化辅助性能得到提升，同时可泛化到域外文化多项选择题与安全分类基准任务中。本文已开源该测试框架、两类数据划分与评判提示词，为文化胜任力的交互式评估提供支撑。

title: CultureConverse: A Multilingual Multi-turn Simulation Harness for Culturally Grounded Assistance in East and Southeast Asia
authors: Bryan Chen Zhengyu Tan, Weihua Zheng, Thong T. Doan, Bich Ngoc Doan, Jia Wang Peh 等 (33 人)
abstract: Current cultural evaluations for large language models (LLMs) often reduce culture to single-turn factual recall via MCQs, failing to capture a common use case: users seeking practical help over multiple turns in culturally grounded scenarios. We introduce CultureConverse, a scalable, multilingual simulation and evaluation harness for culturally grounded assistant dialogue that covers 10 East and Southeast Asian regions, 58 subgroup identities, and 7 domains. Each simulated and evaluated episode produces a scored interaction where the assistant assists the user and infers cultural constraints from partial information. The resulting CultureConverse-DS dataset contains 14,610 benchmark (evaluation) episodes and 274,295 oracle-guided (gold-mode) dialogues. In our benchmark evaluation of 18 models, GPT-5 mini achieves the highest assistance quality. Human annotation experiments suggest that our evaluation framework is a sufficient proxy for human judgment. Performance gains from fine-tuning on 27,860 high-quality CultureConverse-DS samples improve in-domain assistance and transfer out-of-domain to cultural MCQ and safety classification benchmarks. We release the harness, both splits, and judge prompts to support interactive evaluation of cultural competency.

title: BEACON: Behavior-Anchored Cross-Source Knowledge Graph Construction for Cyber Threat Intelligence
title_zh: BEACON：面向网络威胁情报的行为锚定跨源知识图谱构建
authors: Changze Li, Yutong Cheng, Tsania Camila Finnisa, Qian Cui, Wei Ding 等 (6 人)
abstract: Cyber threat intelligence (CTI) is foundational to modern cyber defense, yet much of it resides in unstructured reports whose volume and heterogeneity far exceed manual analysis, motivating research on automatically constructing knowledge graphs from CTI reports. However, existing approaches mainly extract partial information within a single report, leaving the cross-source setting unexplored, where the same threat is given unrelated names. Our key insight is that attack behaviors, once mapped to MITRE ATT&CK (a standardized catalog of attack techniques), can anchor the rest of a report. Attack behaviors are the adversarial actions a report describes, while contextual entities (e.g., threat actors, campaigns, and affected products) and Indicators of Compromise (IoCs; e.g., IP addresses) are their participants and traces. Attaching them to these anchors places every per-report graph in one canonical space.We realize this insight in BEACON, an LLM-driven framework for cross-source CTI knowledge graph construction. Its first stage extracts each report into a graph under a propose-then-verify paradigm, grounding candidates in report evidence and official ATT&CK definitions, to suppress LLM misclassification and hallucination. Its second stage merges these graphs with a hierarchical alignment strategy that applies signals in decreasing order of determinism, from character-level and semantic similarity to overlapping technique neighborhoods, iterating as merges pool neighborhoods. No existing benchmark links entities to technique anchors or provides cross-source alignment ground truth. We therefore construct and release two human-annotated datasets from 34 sources: to our knowledge the largest for report-level CTI extraction (8,395 elements) and the first for cross-source consolidation (3,487). On them, BEACON outperforms all baselines by at least 23% and 9%, respectively.
summary_zh: 网络威胁情报（CTI）是现代网络防御的核心基础，但绝大多数情报存储在非结构化报告中，其庞大的体量与异构性远超人工分析的处理能力，推动了从CTI报告中自动构建知识图谱的相关研究。现有方法大多仅从单份报告中提取部分信息，未探索跨源场景下同一威胁被赋予不同无关名称的问题。本研究的核心思路是：将攻击行为映射到MITRE ATT&CK（标准化攻击技术目录）后，即可作为锚点关联报告中的其余内容。攻击行为是报告描述的对抗动作，而上下文实体（如威胁行为者、攻击活动、受影响产品）与Indicators of Compromise（IoCs，入侵指标，如IP地址）是攻击行为的参与方与痕迹，将其关联到行为锚点后，所有单报告生成的知识图谱均可映射到统一的标准空间。基于该思路，本文实现了BEACON，由大语言模型驱动的跨源CTI知识图谱构建框架：第一阶段采用先提议后验证的范式，将每份报告提取为知识图谱，所有候选内容均关联报告证据与官方ATT&CK定义，抑制大语言模型的误分类与幻觉问题；第二阶段采用层级对齐策略合并所有图谱，按照确定性从高到低依次应用字符级相似度、语义相似度、重叠技术邻域三类信号，随着合并操作聚合邻域信息迭代更新结果。目前尚无现有基准集将实体关联到技术锚点，也未提供跨源对齐的标注真值，因此本文基于34份来源报告构建并开源了两个人工标注数据集：据我们所知，其中一个是当前规模最大的报告级CTI提取数据集（包含8395个元素），另一个是首个跨源CTI整合数据集（包含3487个元素）。在两个数据集上的测试结果显示，BEACON的性能分别比所有基线方法高出至少23%与9%。

title: CamoDocs: A Poisoning Attack Against Retrieval-Augmented Language Models Using Camouflaged Documents
title_zh: CamoDocs：使用伪装文档针对检索增强语言模型的投毒攻击
authors: Jaewon Jung, Haizhong Zheng, Hongsun Jang, Jaeyong Song, Beidi Chen 等 (6 人)
abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) augments LLMs with external documents, but public or user-editable sources expose RAG systems to data poisoning: attackers can inject malicious documents to steer outputs toward targeted answers. Existing poisoning attacks often rely on query inclusion, inserting the target query into poisoned documents to improve retrieval; however, this creates lexical and embedding-space artifacts that make them easy to filter. We propose CamoDocs, a poisoning attack that avoids direct query inclusion by camouflaging adversarial documents among benign content. CamoDocs chunks synthesized benign and adversarial drafts, replaces selected tokens in benign chunks with dispersion tokens that spread poisoned-document embeddings, and applies coherence filtering to limit readability degradation. Across seven RAG defenses, three open-weight LLMs, and three benchmarks, CamoDocs achieves strong average ASR while avoiding query-overlap artifacts exploited by simple query detection. It also remains effective against proprietary models, achieving average ASRs of 61.80% on GPT-5.4-mini and 55.09% on Claude-Haiku-4.5. Finally, we show that erasure-heavy clustering defenses such as TrustRAG can reduce ASR, but only with substantial utility drops on retrieval-dependent benchmarks such as NeoQA. Code is available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过引入外部文档增强大语言模型能力，但公开或支持用户编辑的数据源会让RAG系统面临数据投毒风险：攻击者可注入恶意文档，引导模型输出目标回答。现有投毒攻击通常依赖查询嵌入手段，将目标查询插入投毒文档以提升检索命中率，但该方法会在词法空间与嵌入空间留下明显特征，很容易被过滤机制拦截。本文提出CamoDocs，一种投毒攻击方法，通过将对抗文档伪装在良性内容中，避免直接插入目标查询。CamoDocs将合成的良性草稿与对抗草稿切分为块，在良性块中选中部分token替换为分散token，扩散投毒文档的嵌入分布，同时引入连贯性过滤机制控制内容可读性的下降幅度。在7类RAG防御机制、3款开源大模型与3个基准集上的测试结果显示，CamoDocs可实现极高的平均攻击成功率（ASR），同时不会留下可被简单查询检测方法利用的查询重叠特征。该攻击对闭源模型同样有效，在GPT-5.4-mini上的平均攻击成功率为61.80%，在Claude-Haiku-4.5上的平均攻击成功率为55.09%。最后研究表明，TrustRAG这类以大量内容擦除为核心的聚类防御机制可降低攻击成功率，但会在NeoQA这类依赖检索的基准任务上出现显著的性能下降。相关代码已开源。

title: PersonaForge: Realistic Multi-Turn User Simulation for Agentic Systems
title_zh: PersonaForge：面向智能体系统的真实多轮用户仿真框架
authors: Hanglong Lv, Dawei Zhu, Lei Li, Bowen Ye, Huaqiu Liu 等 (14 人)
abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as agentic workflow executors, yet existing training data and benchmarks largely assume informationally complete, single-turn queries. Our analysis of 16K real-world sessions shows that 75.9% of interactions are multi-turn, revealing a substantial gap between how users interact with agents and how such systems are trained and evaluated. We introduce \textbf{PersonaForge}, a user simulation framework for synthesizing realistic multi-turn user--agent interactions. PersonaForge combines a four-dimensional persona space, SOUL-driven behavioral control calibrated to real-user statistics, and Reverse Deep Construction grounded in authentic seed queries. Using PersonaForge, we construct a 6.3K-record training dataset and \textbf{PersonaForge-Bench}, a manually annotated 138-task benchmark spanning over 20 professional domains with four-dimensional scoring. Experiments on Qwen3.5-27B show that PersonaForge training improves the composite score by +4.1%, with gains across all four dimensions and the largest improvements in Task Completion (+6.0%) and Response Quality (+6.8%). Further analyses show that PersonaForge-trained agents use fewer turns and tool calls, suggesting improved interaction efficiency, while ablations confirm the contribution of SOUL components and adaptive simulation. Together, PersonaForge and PersonaForge-Bench establish a foundation for training and evaluating agents under realistic multi-turn user interaction.
summary_zh: 大语言模型正越来越多地被用作智能体工作流执行器，但现有训练数据和基准测试大多假设查询信息完备、仅为单轮交互。我们对1.6万条真实会话的分析显示，75.9%的交互属于多轮交互，这表明用户与智能体的实际交互模式和这类系统的训练、评估方式之间存在显著差距。本文提出PersonaForge这一用户仿真框架，用于合成真实的多轮用户-智能体交互数据。PersonaForge融合了四维角色空间、经真实用户统计校准的SOUL（行为控制机制）驱动行为控制，以及基于真实种子查询的Reverse Deep Construction（反向深度构建方法）。基于PersonaForge，我们构建了包含6300条记录的训练数据集，以及PersonaForge-Bench这一人工标注基准测试集：后者涵盖20余个专业领域共138项任务，支持四维评分。在Qwen3.5-27B模型上开展的实验表明，经PersonaForge训练后，智能体的综合得分提升4.1%，四个维度的表现均有提升，其中任务完成度（+6.0%）和响应质量（+6.8%）的提升幅度最大。进一步分析显示，经PersonaForge训练的智能体所需交互轮次和工具调用次数更少，交互效率得到提升；消融实验验证了SOUL组件和自适应仿真模块的贡献。PersonaForge和PersonaForge-Bench共同为真实多轮用户交互场景下的智能体训练与评估奠定了基础。

title: Benchmarking large language model agent societies against human behavioural distributions
title_zh: 基于人类行为分布的大语言模型智能体社会基准测试
authors: Raad Bin Tareaf
abstract: Populations of large language model agents are increasingly used as experimental societies. Three doubts shadow every such result: whether the agents behave like the humans they stand in for, whether a finding survives changes to the apparatus that leave the rules untouched, and whether apparent social dynamics are interaction at all rather than the reproduction of experiments the models have read. This article introduces SILICA, an open instrument that tests all three. Five environments carry published human anchors, each paired with perturbations that re-render the same rules and with variants whose payoffs point away from the memorised result. Twelve open-weight models were run through it on a single consumer graphics card. Agreement with human data is confined to starting points: first-round public-goods contributions fall inside the equivalence margin for eight of eleven models, while no model matches end-state contributions or the human corridor of cooperation. Merely swapping the order in which two actions are listed costs one model 58 points of cooperation. Presenting responders with a fixed schedule of offers shows that only one model, the sole reasoning-trained one, places its acceptance threshold where the incentive requires; two move theirs part of the way, two move them the wrong way, and three never acquire one. Conventions form through a shared prior over the names rather than through negotiation, though negotiation reappears once that prior is disrupted. On the certification ladder defined here, current silicon societies support exploratory claims and no more.
summary_zh: 由大量大语言模型智能体组成的群体正越来越多地被用作实验社会系统，但这类研究的结果始终面临三点质疑：智能体的行为是否能代表其模拟的人类群体？在保持规则不变的前提下调整实验装置后，研究结论是否依然成立？观测到的明显社会动力学特征是否本质上只是模型对已读过的实验内容的复现，而非真实的交互行为？本文提出SILICA这一开源工具，可同时验证上述三点疑问。该工具包含5个带有已公开人类行为锚点的环境，每个环境都配套了不改变核心规则的扰动变体，以及收益设置偏离模型记忆结果的对照变体。仅使用单张消费级显卡即可在SILICA上运行12个开源权重大模型。实验结果显示，模型与人类数据的一致性仅存在于初始阶段：11个模型中有8个的首轮公共物品贡献值落在人类数据的等效区间内，但没有任何模型的最终贡献值或合作区间与人类特征匹配。仅交换两个动作的展示顺序，就会导致某一模型的合作度得分下降58分。向响应者展示固定的报价序列时，仅有1个经过推理训练的模型将接受阈值设置在了激励机制要求的位置；2个模型的阈值部分符合要求，2个模型的阈值设置方向完全错误，还有3个模型完全无法形成稳定的接受阈值。群体惯例的形成依赖于对名称的共享先验知识，而非协商过程，只有当该先验知识被破坏后，协商行为才会重新出现。基于本文定义的认证等级，当前的硅基智能体社会仅能支撑探索性研究结论，无法得到更具普适性的可靠结果。

title: FinExam-10K: When Retrieval Helps Financial Reasoning?
title_zh: FinExam-10K：检索技术何时能助力金融推理？
authors: Yan Lin, Jingyu Sun, Zhongliang Guo, Qing Li, Zhuohan Xie 等 (6 人)
abstract: Professional financial examinations require models to combine domain knowledge, calculation, and judgment, yet no benchmark covers the full CFA and FRM structure under one protocol. We introduce FinExam-10K, to our knowledge the largest reported English benchmark for this setting, with 10,198 expert-reannotated questions spanning CFA Levels I-III and FRM Parts I-II. We release 5,110 questions and sequester 5,088 for a quarterly maintained leaderboard. To separate coverage from local answerability, we report a 10,198-item Full-Coverage Track and a 7,625-item Context-Complete Reasoning Track, which is the primary basis for claims about reasoning from the supplied record. Across 17 models, the best accuracy is 85.29% overall. On the frozen Hard band, the best score is 34.68% on the Full-Coverage Track and 54.57% on the 372 context-complete items. All 17 models share 47 context-complete failures. Function-RAG and FunctionGraph-RAG rescue hundreds of errors but also overturn many correct answers, producing little or negative net gain. A gate trained only on public data decides from the question and initial response when FunctionGraph-RAG should run. On the 5,088 held-out items, the gate invokes FunctionGraph-RAG for 7.9% of questions and improves accuracy from 70.83% to 71.23% (p = .0446).
summary_zh: 专业金融考试要求模型同时具备领域知识、计算能力和判断能力，但目前还没有基准测试能在统一协议下覆盖CFA（特许金融分析师）和FRM（金融风险管理师）的全部考核体系。本文提出FinExam-10K，据我们所知这是当前该领域已公开的规模最大的英文基准测试集，包含10198道经专家重新标注的题目，覆盖CFA一至三级和FRM一至二级的全部考核内容。我们公开其中5110道题目，剩余5088道题目将被封存，用于维护按季度更新的排行榜。为了区分知识覆盖度和本地可解答性两个维度，我们设置了两个赛道：包含全部10198道题目的全量覆盖赛道，以及包含7625道题目的上下文完备推理赛道，后者是评估模型基于给定记录开展推理能力的核心基准。在17个主流大模型上开展的测试显示，模型整体最高准确率为85.29%。在冻结的高难度题目子集上，全量覆盖赛道的最高得分为34.68%，而372道上下文完备题目的最高得分为54.57%。17个模型在47道上下文完备题目上全部答错。Function-RAG（检索增强生成）和FunctionGraph-RAG方法可以修正数百个错误，但同时也会推翻大量原本正确的答案，最终带来的净增益极小甚至为负。我们训练了一个仅基于公开数据的门控模块，可根据题目和初始响应判断是否需要调用FunctionGraph-RAG。在5088道封存题目上，该门控模块仅对7.9%的题目触发FunctionGraph-RAG调用，即可将准确率从70.83%提升至71.23%（p=0.0446）。

title: H-Scale: Hessian-Guided Scale Refinement for NVFP4 Sub-Byte LLM Inference
title_zh: H-Scale：面向NVFP4亚字节大语言模型推理的海森引导尺度细化方法
authors: Hao Yu, Zheng Li, Dayiheng Liu, Jianwei Zhang
abstract: The NVIDIA Blackwell architecture, with native support for the ultra-fine-grained NVFP4 format, opens new opportunities for accelerating large language model (LLM) inference. NVFP4's micro-block design, such as a group size of 16, offers strong representational flexibility for capturing local weight distributions and isolating outliers, but it also introduces a large and highly sensitive space of per-group scaling factors. Existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods primarily focus on refining quantized weight values, leaving this scale-selection step underexplored. To address this gap, we propose \textbf{H-Scale}, a lightweight post-processing method for NVFP4 per-group scale refinement. Instead of minimizing plain weight reconstruction error, H-Scale selects hardware-valid group scales using a diagonal second-order proxy derived from calibration activations, thereby targeting layer output perturbation more directly. It is designed as a drop-in replacement for RTN-style scale selection in diverse NVFP4 pipelines, requires only modest offline calibration, and introduces strictly zero overhead at inference time. Under a fixed evaluation protocol, experiments on mainstream LLMs show that H-Scale generally improves a broad range of NVFP4 baselines and brings several variants closer to the BF16 reference.
summary_zh: NVIDIA Blackwell架构原生支持超细粒度的NVFP4数据格式，为大语言模型（LLM）推理加速带来了新机遇。NVFP4的微块设计（例如组大小为16）具备极强的表示灵活性，可捕捉局部权重分布并隔离异常值，但同时也引入了规模庞大、敏感度极高的逐组缩放因子空间。现有训练后量化（PTQ）方法主要聚焦于优化量化权重的取值，对缩放因子选择这一步骤的探索仍不充分。针对这一缺口，本文提出H-Scale这一面向NVFP4逐组尺度细化的轻量级后处理方法。H-Scale不直接最小化普通的权重重构误差，而是利用从校准激活值推导得到的对角二阶代理指标，选择符合硬件要求的组缩放因子，从而更直接地优化层输出扰动。该方法可作为即插即用的替代方案，替换各类NVFP4流水线中的RTN风格缩放因子选择逻辑，仅需少量离线校准工作，且在推理阶段完全不引入额外开销。在统一的评估协议下，主流大模型上的实验结果表明，H-Scale可普遍提升各类NVFP4基线方法的表现，使多个量化变体的精度更接近BF16精度的参考水平。

title: CNeo-Bench: Diagnosing Large Language Models on Chinese Neologisms
title_zh: CNeo-Bench：面向大语言模型中文网络新词能力的诊断基准
authors: Kaiyan Zhao, Zhongtao Miao, Zheyong Xie, Shaosheng Cao, Yoshimasa Tsuruoka
abstract: Chinese neologisms exploit diverse and unique linguistic mechanisms, such as phonetic substitution (e.g., 886 for ``bye-bye'') and visual character decomposition that are rare in other languages. We introduce CNeo-Bench, a benchmark of 4,759 such neologisms with reference definitions, organized into five top-level categories and nine subcategories by the linguistic mechanism behind each expression. CNeo-Bench is paired with a two-tier evaluation framework that separates whether a model can describe a neologism from whether it can operate on its underlying mechanism. Evaluating 18 LLMs, we find that Chinese neologisms remain an open challenge; most models fall below 40\% on definition generation, and on several subcategories a systematic recognition-manipulation gap emerges: models describe neologisms correctly but, in source-form restoration tasks, substitute a semantic equivalent (paraphrase) for the source form rather than producing the source form itself. A few-shot analysis on 1,058 hard items shows that in-context examples can solve many difficult cases, but leave a noticeable portion of errors remaining, indicating challenges beyond prompting alone can address.
summary_zh: 中文网络新词采用了大量其他语言中少见的独特语言机制，例如谐音替换（如用“886”表示“拜拜了”）和字形拆解。本文提出CNeo-Bench这一基准测试集，包含4759个中文网络新词及对应的标准释义，所有词条根据其背后的语言机制被划分为5个一级类别和9个二级类别。CNeo-Bench配套了双层评估框架，分别测试模型描述新词含义的能力，以及操作新词底层语言机制的能力。我们对18个大语言模型开展评估后发现，中文网络新词理解仍是一项开放性挑战：大多数模型的释义生成准确率低于40%，且在多个子类别上出现了明显的“识别-操作鸿沟”：模型可以正确描述新词的含义，但在原形式还原任务中，会输出语义等价的转述内容，而非新词本身的原始形式。针对1058个高难度词条的少样本分析显示，上下文示例可以解决大量难点问题，但仍有相当比例的错误无法消除，说明这类挑战无法仅通过提示工程完全解决。

title: A Shaky Voice Is Not Always a Dodge: Benchmarking Textual and Vocal Evasion Detection in Earnings Calls
title_zh: 颤抖的声音未必是推诿：财报问答场景下文本与语音维度的规避行为检测基准
authors: Mirae Kim, Seonghun Jeong, Youngjun Kwak
abstract: Existing approaches to evasion detection in earnings calls focus on textual transcripts, treating evasion as a single-dimensional phenomenon. We argue that evasion in spoken communication is inherently multidimensional: beyond what executives say, how they say it carries independent and complementary information. To study these dimensions jointly, we introduce DualEvasion, a benchmark for evasion detection across text and audio in earnings call Q&A. The benchmark contains 505 annotated question-answer pairs from 60 earnings calls, each with two independent labels: textual evasion (direct vs. evasive) and vocal cues operationalized as speaker confidence (confident vs. unconfident). Our experiments show that state-of-the-art multimodal models struggle to detect vocal confidence, particularly on unconfident responses. Our analysis suggests these models interpret acoustic cues in isolation rather than relative to each speaker's baseline. Providing speaker-level references yields modest improvements, but a substantial gap with human performance remains.
summary_zh: 现有财报问答场景下的规避行为检测方法大多仅聚焦于文本转录内容，将规避行为视为单维度现象。本文认为口语交流中的规避行为本质上是多维度的：除了高管的表述内容之外，其表达方式也承载着独立且互补的信息。为了联合研究文本和语音两个维度的规避行为特征，本文提出DualEvasion这一财报问答场景下跨文本和音频的规避行为检测基准测试集。该基准包含来自60场财报会议的505条已标注问答对，每条问答对都带有两个独立标签：文本规避标签（直接回答/规避性回答），以及语音线索对应的说话人置信度标签（自信/不自信）。实验结果表明，当前最先进的多模态模型很难准确检测语音维度的置信度，尤其在识别不自信的回答时表现不佳。分析显示，这类模型会孤立地解读声学线索，而非将其与每个说话人的基准特征做对比。引入说话人级别的参考特征可以带来小幅性能提升，但模型表现与人类水平之间仍存在显著差距。

title: Beyond Global Scalars: Synergizing Token-Level Statistics and Deep Semantics for Adversarial AIGC Text Detection
title_zh: 超越全局标量：融合令牌级统计特征与深度语义的对抗性AIGC文本检测
authors: Peiming Li, Yifan Wang, Zhiyuan Hu, Shiyu Li, Zheng Wei 等 (6 人)
abstract: The rapid evolution of large language models necessitates robust machine-generated text detection. Existing paradigms typically follow two isolated tracks. Training-free methods rely on global statistical scalars such as perplexity, while training-based methods utilize semantic hidden states. Both approaches exhibit fundamental vulnerabilities in adversarial scenarios. Global scalars act as lossy compressions that obscure local probabilistic burstiness in interleaved texts, whereas pure semantic models overfit to specific fingerprints and remain susceptible to spoofing. To expose these flaws, we introduce MOSAIC, a comprehensive adversarial benchmark comprising 16000 samples across a full-granularity attack spectrum. To address these challenges, we propose NeuroStat, an end-to-end framework bridging the statistical and semantic gap. NeuroStat captures uncompressed token-level probabilistic logits alongside deep semantic hidden states from a single causal language model backbone. We fuse these heterogeneous signals through Macro-State Residual Modulation, which adaptively calibrates local convolutional features using global uncertainty indicators. Orthogonal and contrastive losses further ensure the learning of complementary representations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NeuroStat maintains exceptional robustness on MOSAIC compared to the severe degradation of state-of-the-art methods, establishing a new standard for adversarial text detection. Code and the MOSAIC benchmark are available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 大语言模型的快速迭代对鲁棒的机器生成文本检测技术提出了更高要求。现有技术路线通常分为两个相互独立的方向：无训练方法依赖困惑度等全局统计标量特征，基于训练的方法则利用语义隐层状态特征。两类方法在对抗场景下都存在根本性缺陷：全局标量是有损压缩特征，会掩盖混合文本中的局部概率突发特性；纯语义模型则会过度拟合特定指纹，极易被攻击欺骗。为了明确暴露这些缺陷，本文提出MOSAIC这一覆盖全粒度攻击谱系的综合性对抗基准测试集，包含16000条样本。针对上述挑战，本文提出NeuroStat这一融合统计与语义特征的端到端框架，可在单个因果语言模型骨干网络上同时提取未压缩的令牌级概率对数特征和深度语义隐层状态。我们通过宏状态残差调制模块融合这些异质特征，利用全局不确定性指标自适应校准局部卷积特征，再通过正交损失和对比损失确保模型学习到互补的表示特征。大量实验结果表明，与现有最先进方法在对抗场景下性能大幅衰减的表现相比，NeuroStat在MOSAIC基准上保持了极强的鲁棒性，树立了对抗性文本检测的新标杆。相关代码和MOSAIC基准可通过公开链接获取。

title: Predicting Turn-Taking Outcomes in Multi-Party Conversation: Interpretable Modelling of Speech and Gaze Dynamics with Interpersonal Closeness
title_zh: QUORUM：面向多标注者的质量优化路由框架
authors: Mark Dourado, Karim Haddad, Henrik G. Hassager, Stefania Serafin
abstract: Smooth speaker transitions are fundamental to effective conversation and rely on an interlocutor's ability to predict when to enter the conversation. This ability depends on accurately interpreting and expressing the verbal and non-verbal cues that signal when a speaker wishes to take or relinquish the floor. The process becomes even more complex in noisy, natural, multi-party settings, with multiple interlocutors available. This study models how gaze and speech, together with perceived interpersonal closeness, signal conversational floor changes in free four-person dialogue. Using the GaMMA corpus, we trained logistic regression models using interpretable, behaviourally motivated features extracted before each turn-taking event to classify floor-transfer outcomes as gaps or overlaps. Predictors included gaze features such as transition motifs and behavioural contrasts, entropy, gaze-based addressee identity, and mutual gaze, alongside speech features derived from speaker loudness, as well as perceived interpersonal closeness (IOS) between speakers. Results show that gaze features capture predictive structure, and that combining them with loudness improves performance (ROC AUC = 0.76 +- 0.04). Loudness reflected speaker control, while gaze dispersion and addressing indexed listener readiness and competitive entry. Performance remained robust across noise conditions, indicating that gaze provides a complementary, noise-resilient cue to turn-taking dynamics.
summary_zh: 数据标注始终是自然语言处理领域的核心瓶颈，需要投入大量人力才能大规模获得高质量标签。大语言模型（LLM）提供了一种快速且低成本的替代方案，但标注可靠性高度依赖样本本身的特性：模型在简单输入上表现良好，但在需要精细推理或上下文理解的样本上经常出错。针对这一问题，本文提出QUORUM（面向多标注者的质量优化路由框架），这是一个考虑预算约束的路由框架，可在固定标注预算下将每个样本动态分配给人工标注者或大语言模型标注者。与之前依赖模型置信度或不确定性估计的方法不同，QUORUM利用基于特征的信号估计样本难度，支持对同一样本开展多次标注，并通过基于一致性的奖励机制融合多个标注结果，提升标注可靠性。我们在英文和多语言场景下的多种闭集、开放域标注任务上对QUORUM开展评估，结果显示与现有同类方法相比，QUORUM可将标注质量最高提升34.4%，同时降低8.8%的标注成本。相关代码可通过公开链接获取。

title: QUORUM: QUality-Optimized Routing Using Multiple annotators
authors: Antonio Purificato, Maria Sofia Bucarelli, Andrea Bacciu, Amin Mantrach, Fabrizio Silvestri
abstract: Data annotation remains a central bottleneck in natural language processing, requiring human effort to obtain high-quality labels at scale. While Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a fast and cost-effective alternative, their reliability is highly instance-dependent: they perform well on simple inputs but often fail on examples requiring nuanced reasoning or contextual understanding. In this work, we address this challenge with QUORUM (QUality-Optimized Routing Using Multiple annotators), a budget-aware routing framework that dynamically assigns each instance to human or LLM annotators under a fixed annotation budget. Unlike prior approaches relying on model confidence or uncertainty estimates, QUORUM leverages feature-based signals to estimate instance difficulty and supports multiple annotations per instance, combining them through agreement-based rewards to improve reliability. We evaluate QUORUM across diverse closed- and open-ended annotation tasks in English and multilingual settings, and QUORUM improves annotation quality by up to 34.4% while reducing costs by 8.8% over competing methods. Code can be found atthis https URL.

title: DisCTI: Who Needs to Know Timely? Automated Sector-Aware Cyber Threat Intelligence Dissemination
title_zh: DisCTI：面向行业感知的自动化网络威胁情报及时分发框架
authors: Fajar Wijitrisnanto, Alsharif Abuadbba, Yansong Gao, Nan Wu
abstract: The timely dissemination of cyber threat intelligence (CTI) is critical for organizations to mount swift and effective incident response. When valid CTI is delivered to the right sector at the right time, identical attacks can often be contained or mitigated. However, today's rapidly expanding CTI landscape overwhelms analysts, who must sift through massive and heterogeneous feeds. Existing platforms such as the Malware Information Sharing Platform (MISP) provide sector tagging features (e.g., energy, finance, government), but in practice, these remain largely unmapped (98% of events are left uncategorized). This lack of automated and timely sector mapping severely limits the operational value of shared intelligence, leaving organizations that belong especially to the critical information infrastructure sector exposed.To address this gap, we formulate sector-targeted CTI dissemination as a multilabel classification problem. Leveraging deep field knowledge of CTI structures and sector-specific threat patterns, we construct a novel data set of 872 sector-labelled CTI events from a threat intelligence platform (TIP). We then apply BERT, a transformer-based model, to automate the mapping of CTI events to sectors. Using the structured threat information expression (STIX) format for cross-platform interoperability, our approach achieves a macro-averaged F1-score of 0.89 at a Hamming loss of 0.055 on the custom dataset, i.e. 94.5% of individual sector-label assignments are correct. These results not only demonstrate the feasibility of sector-aware, automated CTI dissemination but also highlight how embedding expert field knowledge into machine learning design fills a crucial gap in the threat intelligence pipeline, enabling faster and context-relevant defensive action.
summary_zh: 网络威胁情报（CTI）的及时分发是支撑组织快速开展有效事件响应的关键。将有效CTI在正确时间传递给对应行业，通常可以遏制或缓解同类攻击。但当前快速扩张的CTI生态让分析人员不堪重负，他们需要从海量异构的情报源中筛选有效信息。现有平台例如Malware Information Sharing Platform（MISP）虽然提供了行业标签功能（例如能源、金融、政府），但实际使用中98%的事件都未完成分类标注。这种自动化及时行业映射能力的缺失严重限制了共享情报的业务价值，尤其让关键信息基础设施领域的组织面临更高的暴露风险。针对这一缺口，本文将面向特定行业的CTI分发任务建模为多标签分类问题。依托对CTI结构和各行业专属威胁模式的深度领域知识，我们从威胁情报平台（TIP）构建了包含872条带行业标签CTI事件的全新数据集。随后采用基于Transformer架构的BERT模型，自动完成CTI事件到所属行业的映射。采用支持跨平台互操作的STIX（结构化威胁信息表达）格式后，该方法在自定义数据集上的宏平均F1值达到0.89，汉明损失为0.055，即94.5%的单条行业标签分配结果正确。该结果不仅验证了具备行业感知能力的自动化CTI分发的可行性，也表明将专家领域知识嵌入机器学习设计可以填补威胁情报流水线中的关键缺口，支撑更快速、更贴合场景的防御行动。

title: Lexically conditioned realization ambiguity in Korean predicate morphology
title_zh: 韩语谓词形态学中受词汇条件约束的实现歧义研究
authors: Wonjun Oh, KyungTae Lim, Jungyeul Park
abstract: This paper examines Korean surface realization as distinct from morphological analysis. It asks whether a sequence of canonical morphemes and grammatical category labels uniquely determines the corresponding surface form. The answer is negative for a restricted but theoretically revealing class of Korean predicates. In these cases, formally identical or near-identical stem-ending configurations yield different outputs depending on lexical identity and realization class membership. We analyze this phenomenon as homonymy with inflectional divergence, focusing on regular versus digeut irregular pairs, regular versus bieup irregular pairs, and reu irregular versus reo irregular pairs. These cases show that stem shape and ending alone do not always determine surface realization. Instead, lexical meaning, subcategorization, and semantic role structure help identify the intended predicate; the predicate determines the realization class; and the realization class determines the surface form. Korean realization thus reveals a limit of bare morphological representation.
summary_zh: 本文探讨韩语表层实现与形态分析的差异，研究一系列规范语素和语法范畴标签是否能够唯一对应确定的表层形式。针对一类数量有限但具备重要理论研究价值的韩语谓词，上述问题的答案是否定的。在这类案例中，形式相同或近似相同的词尾配置会因词汇属性和所属实现类别的不同产生不同输出。本文将该现象分析为屈折分化下的同形异义现象，重点研究规则活用与digeut（韩语辅音ㄷ）不规则活用对、规则活用与bieup（韩语辅音ㅂ）不规则活用对、reu（韩语辅音ㄹ）不规则活用与reo（韩语音节ㄹㅓ）不规则活用对三类组合。研究结果表明，仅依靠词干形态和词尾并不总能确定表层实现形式；相反，词汇语义、次范畴化和语义角色结构可帮助识别目标谓词，谓词决定其所属实现类别，最终由实现类别确定表层形式。韩语的实现现象揭示了纯形态表征的固有局限性。

title: Entity-Memory Graph Retrieval Improves Evidence Coverage in Long-Conversation Question Answering
title_zh: 实体-记忆图检索提升长对话问答中的证据覆盖度
authors: Shumao Sun
abstract: Entity-Memory graph retrieval keeps dialogue turns as verbatim Memory nodes, links repeated mentions through shared Entities, and connects adjacent Memories with directed chronological edges. At query time the retriever moves from Entity gating through semantic fusion and one-hop chronological recovery to dense backfill. The path can keep a neighboring Memory that dense cosine ranking would otherwise omit. A matched dense control shares the Memory and query vectors, context budget, requested answer protocol, and evaluator, isolating graph structure from changes to the reader.On 1,986 questions from ten LoCoMo conversations, graph retrieval raises official evidence recall at top-k 25 from 79.7468% to 84.4842%. The recall advantage is supported from top-k 5 to 50, while no matched cutoff supports an overall final-answer F1 difference. Four paper-eligible requested configurations support empirical robustness across the tested GPT-3.5 and DeepSeek extractors on both outcomes. Embedding robustness is mixed: F1 has no supported contrast, but recall is sensitive to the embedding artifact. The comparison isolates a retrieval-coverage gain from graph structure. It does not establish a final-answer F1 gain, model or embedding equivalence, or cross-dataset generalization.
summary_zh: 实体-记忆图检索方法将对话轮次作为逐字记忆节点，通过共享实体关联重复提及内容，并用有向时间边连接相邻记忆节点。在查询阶段，检索器从实体门控出发，经过语义融合、单跳时间恢复完成稠密回填，该路径可保留稠密余弦排序会遗漏的相邻记忆。设置的匹配稠密对照组共享记忆向量、查询向量、上下文预算、应答协议和评估器，将图结构的影响与阅读器的变量变化完全隔离。在来自10段LoCoMo长对话的1986个问题上，图检索方法将top-25的官方证据召回率从79.7468%提升至84.4842%，该召回率优势在top-5到top-50区间内均稳定存在，但未观测到最终答案F1值的显著差异。4组符合论文要求的配置在GPT-3.5和DeepSeek两种抽取器上均验证了结果的实证鲁棒性。嵌入层的鲁棒性表现不一：F1值未观测到显著差异，但召回率对嵌入层的伪影较为敏感。本对比实验证实图结构可带来检索覆盖度的提升，但未验证其可带来最终答案F1增益、模型或嵌入层等价性，以及跨数据集泛化能力。

title: What Makes Agent Memory Useful for Reliable Unanswerable Question Handling?
title_zh: 什么因素让智能体记忆可可靠处理不可回答问题？
authors: Chuanyuan Tan, Junjie Yu, Yuxin Wang, Yining Zheng, Xipeng Qiu 等 (6 人)
abstract: Reliable handling of unanswerable questions (UAQs) is critical for trustworthy LLM-based agents. Although memory is widely used in agent systems, its role in reliable UAQ handling remains unclear. We present a systematic study of agent memory for UAQ handling under a unified agentic RAG framework, evaluating four representative memory methods across three UAQ-related datasets and two base models.We find that memory can improve UAQ performance in some settings, but such gains are selective rather than universal and remain fragile under dataset shift. Interestingly, cross-model memory reuse is often more feasible than cross-dataset transfer, suggesting that shifts in answerability patterns pose a greater challenge to memory reuse than changes in the base model itself. We further find that UAQ gains are more strongly preserved through decision guidance than through trajectory shaping, and that memory effectiveness depends strongly on representation. In particular, procedural and rule-based memories often provide the most reliable support for UAQ handling, while memory composition is most effective when procedural guidance is combined with complementary behavioral signals. Overall, our findings suggest that reliable UAQ memory depends less on storing larger amounts of experience and more on preserving transferable behavioral guidance.
summary_zh: 对不可回答问题（UAQ）的可靠处理是构建可信大语言模型智能体的核心要求。尽管记忆机制已在各类智能体系统中广泛应用，但其在可靠UAQ处理中的作用仍不明确。本文在统一的智能体检索增强生成（Agentic RAG）框架下开展针对UAQ处理的智能体记忆系统性研究，在3个UAQ相关数据集、2个基础模型上评估4种代表性记忆方法的表现。研究发现，记忆可在部分场景下提升UAQ处理性能，但这类增益是选择性而非普适性的，且在数据集偏移场景下表现脆弱。有意思的是，跨模型记忆复用通常比跨数据集迁移更易实现，说明可回答性模式的偏移比基础模型本身的变化对记忆复用的挑战更大。进一步研究发现，相较于轨迹塑造，通过决策引导获得的UAQ性能增益更易保留，且记忆的有效性高度依赖其表征形式：特别是过程性和基于规则的记忆通常可为UAQ处理提供最可靠的支撑，而当过程性引导与互补行为信号结合时，记忆组合的效果达到最优。总体而言，研究结果表明适用于UAQ处理的可靠记忆并不依赖存储大量经验，而更注重保留可迁移的行为引导。

title: AI Writers Have a Consistent Stylometric Footprint, but AI Editors Do Not
title_zh: EvoHarmBench：基于迭代类人规避的内容审核突破研究
authors: Zhengyang Shan, Yukyung Lee, Sophie Hao
abstract: Text generated by large language models (LLMs) has been shown to be stylometrically distinct from human-written text \citep{andreDetectingAIAuthorship2023, shahDetectingUnmaskingAIGenerated2023, oparaStyloAIDistinguishingAIGenerated2024, soto2024fewshot, liLinguisticDifferencesAI2025, selviogluFeatureExtractionAnalysis2025}. But LLMs are increasingly used not only to generate text but also to edit human writing, and it is unclear whether the two leave the same trace. We show that AI generation leaves a consistent ``stylometric footprint'': a small subset of features, primarily entropy and lexical diversity, consistently separates AI-generated text from human writing across 8 LLMs and 5 domains, while the remaining features depend heavily on the domain and generator. AI editing, however, does not reproduce the same footprint. Relative to their human-written sources, AI-edited texts show only a small increase in lexical diversity and a decrease in entropy, rather than the joint increase that characterizes AI generation. Lexical density, which contributes little to generation, instead becomes the dominant editing-associated signal. Stylometric features therefore separate AI-edited text from AI-generated text but are substantially less effective at separating it from human-written text. Our results suggest that ``AI text'' is not a single phenomenon: generation and editing leave qualitatively different stylometric traces and should be studied separately.
summary_zh: 现有有害内容检测评估大多基于静态基准数据集，难以反映真实内容平台的交互式对抗生态——用户会根据审核反馈不断调整表达形式，这一特性导致离线基准得分与在线部署效果之间存在显著性能差距。本文提出EvoHarmBench，据我们所知这是首个面向内容审核系统的动态对抗评估框架。该框架采用迭代优化循环，在语义簇层面演进规避策略，同时兼顾规避成功率和人类可读性。研究对真实场景中广泛应用的大语言模型防御模型开展系统性评估，评估覆盖从内容平台采集的5002条真实对抗样本中提取的5类违规类别下的229个语义子簇。实验结果表明，即使是当前领先的商用内容审核系统也存在明显漏洞：经过12轮优化迭代后，在可读性约束下，针对当前最优大语言模型审核器的攻击成功率可达80.3%。本文将发布完整的基准数据、评估框架和代码，推动内容安全研究从静态基准测试向动态对抗评估转型。

title: Is Prosody Lost in Translation? Fine-Grained Cross-Lingual Prosody Similarity Across Languages
title_zh: 合成语言能动性：具身可消亡智能体如何通过有后果的社会经验学习语言可供性
authors: Haopeng Xie, Ismail Rasim Ulgen, Sofia Son, Berrak Sisman, Philipp Koehn
abstract: Prosody plays an important role in speech translation, conveying information such as emphasis, emotion, and intent beyond lexical content. However, despite recent progress in expressive speech-to-speech translation (S2ST), little is known about how prosodic patterns are similar/different across languages. Understanding these cross-lingual similarities and differences is crucial for effectively incorporating prosody into expressive S2ST systems. In this work, we present the first fine-grained cross-lingual analysis of prosody using multilingual dubbing data across English-German, English-Spanish, and English-French language pairs. We analyze the similarity of pitch, energy, and temporal feature patterns between source and target speech and investigate the linguistic and alignment-related factors affecting this similarity. Our analysis reveals inherent cross-lingual correlations in prosodic structure between certain languages. The findings provide important insights into the transferability of prosody across languages and offer empirical guidance for future expressive speech-to-speech translation systems.
summary_zh: 当代大语言模型可实现流畅对话并影响人类决策，但其交互过程并不具备属于自身的、持续且易受影响的生命属性。语言能动性理论将这一缺失的属性定义为语言能动性，通过具身性、语言参与性和不稳定性三个维度对其进行刻画：即能够行动并承担后果的身体、可同时改变智能体和交互对象的交互过程，以及可延续或终止的未来状态。本研究通过两项协同实验探究该属性如何在人工系统中实现：首先将上述关系转化为可检验的合成语言能动性（SLA）判定标准，识别出若干现有SLA系统；其次在稳态调节强化学习的基础上，开发基于消亡属性的语言强化学习模型，将其实例化为具身可消亡智能体（EMA）。该智能体可学习不同表达方式如何改变交互对象对其的保护意愿，并通过评估这些响应对自身剩余生命周期的影响选择表达内容。对照实验结果表明，智能体的语言选择依赖其身体状态和社会历史，可改变交互对象的行为，并可通过与特定交互对象的经验积累完成自适应调整。当身体的后果持续存在时，语言选择会改变同一生命的未来走向；当身体被重置后，其社会效应仍然存在，但不再影响后续的生存状态。最终得到的智能体在本研究的操作定义下表现出合成语言能动性。本研究可推动合成共情与战略性人机交互领域的进一步探索：具备持续身体、历史和未来的人工智能体如何发展并表达共情，以及人类如何对其开展关怀、协商和治理。

title: EvoHarmBench: Breaking Content Moderation with Iterative Human-Like Evasion
authors: Ruijie Jian, Benlei Cui, Ting Ma, Haidong Ding, Kangwei Liu 等 (11 人)
abstract: Existing evaluations of harmful content detection rely predominantly on static benchmarks, which struggle to reflect the interactive adversarial ecosystem of real-world content platforms where users continuously revise their expressions in response to moderation feedback. This mismatch creates a significant performance gap between offline benchmark scores and online deployment effectiveness. To the best of our knowledge, we present EvoHarmBench, the first dynamic adversarial evaluation framework for content moderation systems. The framework employs an iterative optimization loop that evolves evasion strategies at the semantic-cluster level, while simultaneously optimizing for evasion success and human readability. We systematically evaluate LLM-based defense models which are widely used in real world moderation systems. The evaluation covers 229 semantic sub-clusters across five violation categories, derived from 5,002 real-world adversarial samples collected from content platforms. Our experiments reveal substantial vulnerabilities even in leading commercial systems: after twelve optimization iterations, the attack success rate under readability constraints reaches 80.3% within SOTA LLM moderators. We will release the full benchmark data, evaluation framework, and code to encourage a shift from static benchmarking toward dynamic adversarial evaluation in content safety research.

title: Synthetic Linguistic Agency: How an Embodied Mortal Agent Learns Linguistic Affordances through Consequential Social Experience
authors: Sixin Chen, Taizhou Chen
abstract: Contemporary language models can converse fluently and influence human decisions, yet their exchanges do not enter a continuing, vulnerable life of their own. Linguistic-agency theory identifies this missing connection as linguistic agency and characterizes it through embodiment, linguistic participation, and precariousness: a body that acts and bears consequences, interaction that changes both agent and partner, and a future that can be sustained or lost. Two coordinated studies examine how this organization can appear in artificial systems. First, we translate these relations into inspectable criteria for Synthetic Linguistic Agency (SLA) and identify several existing SLA systems. Second, building on Homeostatically Regulated Reinforcement Learning, we develop a mortality-grounded linguistic-reinforcement-learning model and instantiate it in an Embodied Mortal Agent (EMA). The EMA learns how ways of speaking change a partner's willingness to protect it and chooses expressions by considering what those responses mean for its remaining life. Controlled experiments show that linguistic choices depend on the EMA's body and social history, change partner behavior, and adapt through experience with particular partners. When bodily consequences persist, linguistic choices alter the future of the same life; when the body is reset, their social effects remain but no longer shape continued viability. The resulting EMA exhibits SLA under our operational definition. This work motivates further research on synthetic empathy and strategic human-AI interaction: how artificial agents with persistent bodies, histories, and futures might develop and express empathy, and how people might care for, negotiate with, or govern them.

title: Auditing Generative Audio Calls for Known-Task Audio-LLM Evaluation
title_zh: 面向已知任务音频大语言模型评估的生成式音频调用审计方法
authors: Mengzhe Geng
abstract: Speech and audio LLMs are often evaluated by asking whether a waveform prompt beats an automatic speech recognition (ASR) transcript. For known closed-set tasks, that comparison conflates two factors: access to acoustic evidence and the need to call a generative audio model. We evaluate this distinction as a controlled call-decision problem. For each example, a policy chooses among keeping a transcript label, using encoder evidence from Contrastive Language-Audio Pretraining (CLAP), Audio Spectrogram Transformer (AST), or WavLM, and calling Qwen2-Audio, Qwen2.5-Omni, or MOSS-Audio; the decisive ablation removes all generative actions while keeping the selector and development protocol fixed. On VocalSound, transcripts reach 0.296 accuracy, so waveform information is needed. Yet supervised CLAP and WavLM controls reach 0.850 and 0.854 with no generative audio calls. A selector with generative actions reaches 0.925 accuracy using 12.5% calls, compared with 0.921 for the matched no-call selector (paired difference 0.004; 95% CI [-0.025,0.033]). Agreement and stacking features improve weaker selectors but do not beat the strongest no-call control. For known-task endpoint claims, the relevant quantity is the marginal value of the generative call after transcript and encoder evidence have already been used.
summary_zh: 当前语音音频大语言模型的评估通常对比波形提示与自动语音识别（ASR）转录文本的表现优劣，对于已知闭集任务，该对比方法混淆了两个独立因素：获取声学证据的能力，以及调用生成式音频模型的必要性。本文将该区分作为受控调用决策问题开展评估：对于每一个样本，决策器可选择保留转录标签、使用对比语言-音频预训练（CLAP）、音频频谱变换器（AST）或WavLM的编码器证据，也可选择调用Qwen2-Audio、Qwen2.5-Omni或MOSS-Audio模型。核心消融实验在保持选择器和开发协议不变的前提下移除所有生成式调用操作。在VocalSound数据集上，仅使用转录文本的准确率为0.296，说明该任务需要波形信息；但无生成式调用的监督CLAP和WavLM对照组准确率分别达到0.850和0.854。支持生成式调用的选择器仅使用12.5%的调用占比即可达到0.925的准确率，与之匹配的无调用选择器准确率为0.921（配对差异为0.004，95%置信区间为[-0.025, 0.033]）。一致性校验和堆叠特征可提升弱选择器的表现，但无法超过最优的无调用对照组。对于已知任务的端点性能评估，相关核心指标是在已使用转录文本和编码器证据的前提下，生成式调用带来的边际增益。

title: PersonaEdit: Representative Sample Selection for Personalized Model Editing
title_zh: PersonaEdit：面向个性化模型编辑的代表性样本选择方法
authors: You-Mei Huang, Chung-Chi Chen, An-Zi Yen
abstract: Personalization has attracted growing interest in LLM applications, yet existing retrieval-based approaches depend heavily on retrieval quality and degrade in long-term interactions. Model editing, which directly modifies internal model parameters to incorporate new knowledge, has demonstrated effective knowledge modification capabilities in factual knowledge editing tasks and may provide a potential solution for personalization. However, scaling model editing to personalization is non-trivial. Editing large amounts of user data increases computational cost and causes interference among edits, motivating the need for effective sample selection. To address this issue, we propose, PersonaEdit, a hidden representation clustering strategy that selects representative editing samples through proportional stratified sampling. Experiments show that model editing is effective for personalization, and that our selection strategy preserves most of the performance while substantially reducing the number of required editing samples. Beyond standalone editing, we find that combining model editing with retrieval-based prompt augmentation further improves personalization, as edited knowledge and retrieved context provide complementary information. These results demonstrate the potential of model editing as an efficient and scalable approach for LLM personalization.
summary_zh: 大语言模型的个性化应用近年来受到广泛关注，但现有基于检索的个性化方法高度依赖检索质量，在长时交互场景下性能会出现衰减。模型编辑技术通过直接修改模型内部参数注入新知识，已在事实知识编辑任务中展现出优秀的知识修改能力，有望为个性化需求提供可行解决方案。但将模型编辑扩展到个性化场景并非易事：编辑大量用户数据会提升计算成本，还会引发不同编辑操作之间的相互干扰，因此亟需高效的样本选择方法。针对该问题，本文提出PersonaEdit，一种基于隐表征聚类的策略，通过比例分层采样选择代表性编辑样本。实验结果表明，模型编辑可有效实现个性化，本文提出的选择策略可在保留绝大多数性能的前提下大幅减少所需的编辑样本数量。除独立编辑操作外，将模型编辑与基于检索的提示增强相结合可进一步提升个性化效果，编辑得到的知识与检索得到的上下文可形成信息互补。上述结果证明模型编辑是实现大语言模型高效可扩展个性化的潜在可行路径。

title: Representation of syntax in LLMs through the lens of linear distance and similarity-aware entropy
title_zh: 基于线性距离与相似度感知熵视角的大语言模型句法表征研究
authors: Juan Pablo Vigneaux, Mary Kennedy, Khalil Iskarous, Robert Frank, Matilde Marcolli
abstract: Structural probes were introduced by Hewitt and Manning to reconstruct syntactic trees from a neural language model's latent representations. They are evaluated by calculating the proportion of syntactic tree edges correctly reconstructed over an annotated corpus (as measured by undirected unlabeled attachment score). Here, we disaggregate this measure, considering undirected attachment score by label (UASL), which assesses the reconstruction accuracy of each syntactic relation separately, establishing important differences among relations that overlap linguistic distinctions. Moreover, we identify two factors that predict most of UASL's variability across relations: (i) the mean and dispersion of the linear distance (on a log scale) between the related words, and (ii) the diversity (similarity-aware entropy) of the syntactic relation's head. These results, which hold across a range of model sizes and architectures, shed light on the degree of abstraction of the representation of syntax in language models and the dependence of such representation on geometric properties of the embedding space.
summary_zh: 结构探测方法由Hewitt和Manning提出，用于从神经语言模型的隐表征中重建句法树，其评估方式是计算标注语料库中正确重建的句法树边占比（采用无向无标签附着得分衡量）。本研究对该评估指标进行拆解，提出按标签分类的无向附着得分（UASL），可分别评估每类句法关系的重建准确率，识别出不同句法关系之间与语言学差异对应的核心区别。研究进一步确定了可解释大部分UASL跨关系变异的两个核心因素：（1）相关词语之间线性距离（对数尺度）的均值和离散度；（2）句法关系中心词的多样性（相似度感知熵）。上述结果在不同模型规模和架构下均成立，可揭示语言模型句法表征的抽象程度，以及该表征对嵌入空间几何属性的依赖特性。

title: SURE-Challenge: Evaluating Speech Evidence Before Speech-LLM Generation
title_zh: SURE-Challenge（语音不支持场景拒绝评估挑战赛）：语音大语言模型生成前的语音证据评估
authors: Mengzhe Geng
abstract: Speech LLMs are usually graded after they answer, although an operating system first has to decide whether a waveform should be sent to the model. We define the Speech-Unsupported Rejection Evaluation Challenge (SURE-Challenge) for this admission step. The benchmark pairs LibriSpeech-derived transcription and first-word question answering with unsupported silence, colored noise, synthetic tones, and source-ambiguous babble under disjoint source splits. Front-end ablations use Qwen2-Audio; the selected energy-plus-Whisper-score rule is then replayed before six speech/audio LLMs. On the 474-row leakage-screened SURE-Extended test set, raw Qwen2-Audio rejects 15/204 unsupported inputs, whereas the fixed rule rejects 196/204 and leaves supported accuracy unchanged. External checks delimit this number: Common Voice retention drops as the Whisper-score threshold is tightened, and no-speed babble gives 18 to 24 rejected clips out of 54 across regenerated seeds. The result identifies a pre-generation error mode missed by answer-only scoring.
summary_zh: 当前语音大语言模型（Speech LLMs）通常在生成回答后才被评估性能，但实际部署场景下操作系统首先需要判断输入波形是否应当送入模型处理。本文针对这一准入环节定义了语音不支持场景拒绝评估挑战赛（Speech-Unsupported Rejection Evaluation Challenge, SURE-Challenge）。该基准将源自LibriSpeech数据集的转录任务、首词问答任务，与非支持类输入（包括静音、有色噪声、合成音、声源歧义混响）配对构建，且采用互不重叠的源数据划分规则。前端消融实验基于Qwen2-Audio开展，筛选出的能量+Whisper评分规则随后在6款语音/音频大语言模型上完成验证。在经过474条样本泄漏筛查的SURE-Extended测试集上，原生Qwen2-Audio仅能正确拒绝204条非支持输入中的15条，而本文提出的固定规则可拒绝其中196条，且不会降低支持类输入的识别准确率。外部校验进一步验证了该结果的边界：随着Whisper评分阈值收紧，Common Voice数据集的保留率会逐步下降；在不同随机种子生成的54条无语速混响测试样本中，该规则可正确拒绝18~24条样本。研究结果证实了仅基于回答结果的评分体系会遗漏生成前阶段的一类典型错误模式。

title: Informational Antilocality and the Locality Bias in LLMs
title_zh: 信息反局域性与大语言模型中的局域性偏差
authors: Andrew McInnerney, Shane Storks, Steven Abney, Richard L. Lewis
abstract: We consider the ability of transformer-based language models (LLMs) to learn what we call k-antilocal languages, i.e., languages that have no mutual information across any span of $k$ contiguous symbols. We construct such languages with increasing $k$, finding that LLMs trained on them achieve comparable cross-entropy loss regardless of antilocality, but converge more slowly on more antilocal languages. Our findings support the idea that non-local dependencies are more difficult to learn, but the evidence for this bias comes from learning speed rather than learning success.
summary_zh: 本文研究基于Transformer架构的大语言模型（LLMs）学习k反局域语言的能力，这类语言的定义是任意k个连续符号的跨片段互信息均为0。我们构造了k值逐步递增的多组反局域语言数据集，发现大语言模型在这类数据集上训练得到的交叉熵损失与反局域性程度无关，但在反局域性更强的语言上收敛速度更慢。该结果支撑了非局部依赖关系更难学习的结论，且这类偏差的证据来源于学习速度差异而非最终学习效果的差异。

title: Load-Bearing Context: The Question Damage Score for Evaluating Context Reliance in Linguistic Reasoning
title_zh: 承载型上下文：用于评估语言推理中上下文依赖度的问题损伤评分
authors: Neh Majmudar, Elena Filatova
abstract: Determining whether large language models derive answers from context or prior knowledge remains a fundamental challenge. Self-contained linguistic olympiad puzzles provide a controlled setting where all answers derive solely from expert-designed context examples without external knowledge. Removing individual context examples can eliminate information needed for specific questions while leaving the rest of the puzzle unchanged. We leverage this to introduce a diagnostic framework for analyzing individual context examples. Using 53 UK Linguistics Olympiad puzzles, we generate two modified variants by deleting a single context example: (1) uniform random deletion, and (2) targeted deletion (inspired by error-correcting codes) to remove a structurally load-bearing example uniquely carrying necessary information. We formalize this impact using a Question Damage Score to classify puzzles as fragile or robust. Evaluating three frontier LLMs under instructions to abstain when information is insufficient, we find they rarely abstain, often continuing to produce correct answers after load-bearing context is removed. These findings motivate further investigation into context-based reasoning, prior knowledge, memorization, and linguistic inference. Beyond abstention, the framework enables fine-grained analyses of context reliance, including causal interventions, stopping-set analysis, targeted contamination studies, and mechanistic interpretability.
summary_zh: 判断大语言模型的回答来源于输入上下文还是自身先验知识，是当前领域的核心挑战之一。自包含式语言奥赛谜题提供了完全受控的实验环境：所有问题的答案都仅来自专家设计的上下文示例，无需调用外部知识。移除单个上下文示例可以消除特定问题所需的信息，同时不影响谜题其余部分的有效性。基于该特性本文提出了一套用于分析单个上下文示例的诊断框架。我们基于53道英国语言学奥林匹克谜题，通过删除单个上下文示例生成两类修改变体：（1）均匀随机删除，（2）受纠错码启发的定向删除，用于移除唯一承载必要信息的结构承载型示例。我们通过问题损伤评分（Question Damage Score）对该影响进行形式化定义，将谜题划分为脆弱型和鲁棒型两类。在要求信息不足时主动拒答的指令下对3款前沿大语言模型开展评估，发现模型极少触发拒答行为，甚至在承载型上下文被移除后仍经常输出正确答案。该发现将推动学界进一步研究基于上下文的推理机制、先验知识作用、模型记忆行为与语言推理逻辑。除拒答行为分析外，该框架还支持对上下文依赖度的细粒度分析，可应用于因果干预、停止集分析、定向污染研究与可解释性机制分析等场景。

title: Below the Noise Floor: Bimodal Seed Collapse and Distinct Failure Modes in Small-Model Knowledge Distillation
title_zh: 噪声底限以下：小模型知识蒸馏中的双峰种子崩溃现象与差异化失效模式
authors: Dipto Sumit, Sakib Ul Haque, Farig Sadeque
abstract: Function routing -- selecting the correct API call from a fixed catalog given a natural-language request -- is a deployment problem where small students are attractive but knowledge distillation gains are typically reported single-seed, at scales where seed variance is unknown. On a 740-instance healthcare API routing task with a 1.5B Qwen student and a 20B teacher, we compare eight KD variants against supervised cross-entropy, using three to six seeds for key configurations.
